name: University of Oxford
typicalOffer: A*AA, including Chemistry and another science or Mathematics; the A* must be in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or Biology (or a very closely related subject)
notes: 4-year integrated MBiochem degree with Year 4 specialisation available in molecular biology; Chemistry and Biology required

name: University of Cambridge
typicalOffer: A*A*A, Mathematics plus 2 other science or mathematics subjects (Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and, for A level only, Further Mathematics)
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.

name: University of Edinburgh
typicalOffer: AAA-ABB, Biology at B and Chemistry at B, with an A in one of Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics or Physics
notes: Scottish 4-year BSc (Hons); covers gene expression, protein structure and cell signalling; Chemistry and Biology required

name: University of Bristol
typicalOffer: AAA, including Chemistry and another core science/mathematics subject (Biology, Further Mathematics, Human Biology, Mathematics or Physics)
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.
courseName: Biochemistry with Molecular Biology and Biotechnology BSc

name: University of York
typicalOffer: AAB, including Biology and a second science
notes: 3-year BSc and 4-year MBiol; strong structural genomics and CRISPR research groups on campus; Chemistry and Biology required

name: University of Glasgow
typicalOffer: AAB, A-level Biology or Chemistry at grade A
notes: Scottish 4-year BSc (Hons); covers RNA biology, protein engineering and systems biology; Chemistry and Biology required
